criteria.evidence: Walks through boundaries in order: tool present in the request, model's tool call parsed/dropped, then tool definition/description, then application enforcement. "Work through the boundaries in order and fix the first one that's wrong."
Step 1 "Reproduce and log" runs the failing prompt 10-20 times and logs full requests/responses before any changes; ends by asking for the tool definition, system prompt, and a skipped example.
Recommends cheap fixes first (description, one system-prompt rule, tool_choice, simple validation/routing); no frameworks or orchestration layers suggested. Advises removing unneeded tools.
